key_insight: AgentODE uses an LLM plus iterative inference to discover ODE mechanisms and estimate parameter distributions from only aggregate summary statistics.
clinical_relevance: This could help model rare diseases with sparse, noisy, privacy-sensitive data by supporting interpretable population-level mechanistic analysis.
method: A tool-augmented agent refines parameter distributions in a diagnosis-update loop.
Learning uses population-level summary statistics instead of individual-level data.
evidence_signal: The authors evaluated the approach on three benchmarks and two clinical datasets, including RDEB with only 231 observations from 46 patients.
watch_item: Results depend on summary-statistic quality and LLM-guided structure search, so incorrect summaries or biased candidate models could still lead to implausible mechanisms.
paper_title: LLM-Guided ODE Discovery and Parameter Inference from Small-Cohort Aggregate Data
